headline: AUM's unbeaten start ends at North Georgia
dek: AUM had won all three of their matches before the trip to North Georgia, and the defeat there is the first of their season. They go back to the Gulf South Conference with three wins and one loss, their perfect record gone before conference play has begun.
displaced_by: results night: AUM's unbeaten start ended at North Georgia, the strongest first-defeat story of the 22 results
